chapterInfo.content:
18
Paulo wɔ Korinto
1Yeinom akyiri no, Paulo firii Atene kɔɔ Korinto. 2#Rom 16.3 Na ɔhunuu Yudani bi a ne din de Akwila a wɔwoo no Ponto, na ɔfiri Italia baa hɔ nkyɛreeɛ, ne ne yere Priskila, ɛfiri sɛ Klaudio ahyɛ sɛ Yudafoɔ nyinaa mfiri Roma nkɔ. Paulo kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn, 3#Aso 20.34; 1 Ko 4.12 na ɛnam sɛ ɔne wɔn yɛ adwuma baako nti, ɔtenaa wɔn nkyɛn yɛɛ adwuma; ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ ntomadanyɛfoɔ. 4Na daa homeda ɔkɔka asɛm hyiadan mu maa Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ gye diiɛ.
5 # Aso 17.14-15 Na Silas ne Timoteo firi Makedonia baeɛ no, Paulo de nnam kaa asɛm no na ɔdii adanseɛ kyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no. 6#Aso 13.51; 20.26 Na wɔtuaa ano na wɔkaa abususɛm no, ɔporoo n’atadeɛ mu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mogya ngu mo ara mo atifi; me deɛ, me ho afi. Ɛfiri nnɛ merekɔ amanaman no mu.
7Ɛnna ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ obi a ne din de Tito Yusto a ɔyɛ onyamesuroni, a ne fie bata hyiadan ho no nkyɛn. 8#1 Ko 1.14 Na hyiadan mu panin Krispo ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa gyee Awurade diiɛ, na Korintofoɔ mu bebree a wɔteeɛ no nso gye dii maa wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu. 9#1 Ko 2.3 Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Paulo anisoadehunu mu anadwo sɛ: Nsuro, kasa, na mmua w’ano! 10#Yer 1.8; Yoh 10.16 Ɛfiri sɛ meka wo ho, na obiara renka wo mmɛyɛ wo hwee; na mewɔ nkurɔfoɔ pii kuro yi mu. 11Na ɔtenaa hɔ afe ne abosome nsia kyerɛkyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ wɔn mu.
12Na Galio di Akaia amrado no, Yudafoɔ no de ano korɔ sɔre tiaa Paulo, na wɔde no kɔɔ asɛnnie adwa anim 13kaa sɛ: Oyi tu nnipa aso sɛ wɔnkwati mmara no nsom Onyankopɔn. 14#Aso 25.18-20 Na Paulo yɛɛ sɛ ɔrebɛbue n’ano no, Galio ka kyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ no sɛ: Yudafoɔ, sɛ ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛntene anaa abususɛm bi a, anka ɛsɛ sɛ metie mo; 15#Yoh 18.31 na sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm ne din ne mo mmara ho asɛmmisa bi deɛ a, ɛnneɛ mo ara monhwɛ! Na me deɛ, merenyɛ saa nsɛm yi temmufoɔ. 16Na ɔpamoo wɔn firii asɛnniiɛ hɔ. 17Na Helafoɔ no nyinaa faa hyiadan mu panin Sostene hwee no asɛnniiɛ hɔ, nanso Galio ammu yeinom biara.
Paulo sane kɔ Antiokia
18 # Aso 21.24; Num 6.9; 6.18 Na Paulo kɔɔ so tenaa hɔ kyɛree kakra ara yie no, ɔkraa anuanom no, ɔfirii hɔ faa nsuo ani kɔɔ Siria a Priskila ne Akwila ka ne ho; na ɔyii ne ti wɔ Kenkrea; ɛfiri sɛ na wadi nseɛ. 19Na wɔbaa Efeso, na ɔgyaa wɔn hɔ; na ɔno ara deɛ, ɔkɔɔ hyiadan mu ne Yudafoɔ kɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dendeenden. 20Na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔntena wɔn nkyɛn nkyɛre kakra no, wampene. 21#1 Ko 4.19; Yak 4.15 Na ɔkraa wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ a, mɛsane maba mo nkyɛn bio. Na ɔfirii Efeso sii nsuo ani. 22#Aso 21.15 Na ɔsii fam wɔ Kaesarea no, ɔkɔɔ Yerusalem kɔkyeaa asafo no, na ɔsane kɔɔ Antiokia.
23Na ɔkyɛree hɔ kakra no, ɔfirii hɔ kɔkyinii Galatia ne Frigia nkuro nyinaa mu hyɛɛ asuafoɔ no nyinaa den.
Apolo wɔ Efeso ne Korinto
24 # 1 Ko 3.6 Na Yudani bi a ne din de Apolo, a wɔwoo no Aleksandria, onipa a n’ano ateɛ na ɔyɛ nam wɔ twerɛsɛm no mu, baa Efeso. 25#Aso 19.3 Oyi na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no Awurade kwan soɔ; na ɔyɛ hye honhom mu nti, ɔkasae, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Yesu ho nsɛm yie, nso Yohane asubɔ nkutoo na na ɔnim. 26Ɔfirii aseɛ de akokoɔduro kasaa hyiadan mu. Na Priskila ne Akwila teeɛ no, wɔfaa no baa wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔkyerɛɛ no Nyankopɔn kwan pɛpɛɛpɛ. 27Na ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛsene akɔ Akaia no, anuanom no hyɛɛ no den, na wɔtwerɛɛ nwoma kɔsrɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ wɔnnye no. Na ɔduruu hɔ no, ɔboaa wɔn a wɔnam adom so agye adie no pii. 28#Aso 9.22; 17.3 Na ɔde n’asɛm kaa Yudafoɔ no gui wɔ badwam, nam twerɛsɛm so kyerɛɛ pefee sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no.

Yeinom akyiri no, Paulo firii Atene kɔɔ Korinto. Na ɔhunuu Yudani bi a ne din de Akwila a wɔwoo no Ponto, na ɔfiri Italia baa hɔ nkyɛreeɛ, ne ne yere Priskila, ɛfiri sɛ Klaudio ahyɛ sɛ Yudafoɔ nyinaa mfiri Roma nkɔ. Paulo kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn, na ɛnam sɛ ɔne wɔn yɛ adwuma baako nti, ɔtenaa wɔn nkyɛn yɛɛ adwuma; ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ ntomadanyɛfoɔ. Na daa homeda ɔkɔka asɛm hyiadan mu maa Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ gye diiɛ.
Na Silas ne Timoteo firi Makedonia baeɛ no, Paulo de nnam kaa asɛm no na ɔdii adanseɛ kyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no. Na wɔtuaa ano na wɔkaa abususɛm no, ɔporoo n’atadeɛ mu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mogya ngu mo ara mo atifi; me deɛ, me ho afi. Ɛfiri nnɛ merekɔ amanaman no mu.
Ɛnna ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ obi a ne din de Tito Yusto a ɔyɛ onyamesuroni, a ne fie bata hyiadan ho no nkyɛn. Na hyiadan mu panin Krispo ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa gyee Awurade diiɛ, na Korintofoɔ mu bebree a wɔteeɛ no nso gye dii maa wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Paulo anisoadehunu mu anadwo sɛ: Nsuro, kasa, na mmua w’ano! Ɛfiri sɛ meka wo ho, na obiara renka wo mmɛyɛ wo hwee; na mewɔ nkurɔfoɔ pii kuro yi mu. Na ɔtenaa hɔ afe ne abosome nsia kyerɛkyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ wɔn mu.
Na Galio di Akaia amrado no, Yudafoɔ no de ano korɔ sɔre tiaa Paulo, na wɔde no kɔɔ asɛnnie adwa anim kaa sɛ: Oyi tu nnipa aso sɛ wɔnkwati mmara no nsom Onyankopɔn. Na Paulo yɛɛ sɛ ɔrebɛbue n’ano no, Galio ka kyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ no sɛ: Yudafoɔ, sɛ ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛntene anaa abususɛm bi a, anka ɛsɛ sɛ metie mo; na sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm ne din ne mo mmara ho asɛmmisa bi deɛ a, ɛnneɛ mo ara monhwɛ! Na me deɛ, merenyɛ saa nsɛm yi temmufoɔ. Na ɔpamoo wɔn firii asɛnniiɛ hɔ. Na Helafoɔ no nyinaa faa hyiadan mu panin Sostene hwee no asɛnniiɛ hɔ, nanso Galio ammu yeinom biara.

Na Paulo kɔɔ so tenaa hɔ kyɛree kakra ara yie no, ɔkraa anuanom no, ɔfirii hɔ faa nsuo ani kɔɔ Siria a Priskila ne Akwila ka ne ho; na ɔyii ne ti wɔ Kenkrea; ɛfiri sɛ na wadi nseɛ. Na wɔbaa Efeso, na ɔgyaa wɔn hɔ; na ɔno ara deɛ, ɔkɔɔ hyiadan mu ne Yudafoɔ kɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dendeenden. Na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔntena wɔn nkyɛn nkyɛre kakra no, wampene. Na ɔkraa wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ a, mɛsane maba mo nkyɛn bio. Na ɔfirii Efeso sii nsuo ani. Na ɔsii fam wɔ Kaesarea no, ɔkɔɔ Yerusalem kɔkyeaa asafo no, na ɔsane kɔɔ Antiokia.
Na ɔkyɛree hɔ kakra no, ɔfirii hɔ kɔkyinii Galatia ne Frigia nkuro nyinaa mu hyɛɛ asuafoɔ no nyinaa den.

Na Yudani bi a ne din de Apolo, a wɔwoo no Aleksandria, onipa a n’ano ateɛ na ɔyɛ nam wɔ twerɛsɛm no mu, baa Efeso. Oyi na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no Awurade kwan soɔ; na ɔyɛ hye honhom mu nti, ɔkasae, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Yesu ho nsɛm yie, nso Yohane asubɔ nkutoo na na ɔnim. Ɔfirii aseɛ de akokoɔduro kasaa hyiadan mu. Na Priskila ne Akwila teeɛ no, wɔfaa no baa wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔkyerɛɛ no Nyankopɔn kwan pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛsene akɔ Akaia no, anuanom no hyɛɛ no den, na wɔtwerɛɛ nwoma kɔsrɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ wɔnnye no. Na ɔduruu hɔ no, ɔboaa wɔn a wɔnam adom so agye adie no pii. Na ɔde n’asɛm kaa Yudafoɔ no gui wɔ badwam, nam twerɛsɛm so kyerɛɛ pefee sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
